questionText:
Consider the following table:

AlgorithmsDesign Paradigms
(P) Kruskal(i) Divide and Conquer
(Q) Quicksort(ii) Greedy
(R) Floyd-Warshall(iii) Dynamic Programming

Match the algorithms to the design paradigms they are based on.
explanation:
Step-by-step analysis:

1. (P) Kruskal's algorithm is a minimum spanning tree algorithm that follows the Greedy algorithm (ii) paradigm.

2. (Q) Quicksort is a sorting algorithm that follows the Divide and Conquer (i) strategy.

3. (R) Floyd-Warshall algorithm is an all-pairs shortest path algorithm that uses Dynamic Programming (iii).

Therefore, the correct matching is $(P) \leftrightarrow (ii)$, $(Q) \leftrightarrow (i)$, and $(R) \leftrightarrow (iii)$, which corresponds to Option (C).
